rePredRet: Retention Time Prediction Statistics

Automated predictions from RepoRT data

Source: vignettes/index.qmd

Overview

rePredRet is a reimplementation of PredRet that predicts retention times (RTs) by directly mapping between chromatographic systems using monotonically constrained GAMs. It uses data from the RepoRT repository and publishes predictions to GitHub.
